utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Sam, just so you know, I'm planning to set up the repair drive schedule this weekend, and Jules is spreading the word on Maple Street and at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, let me know if you need any help with the schedule or if there's anything I can do to support Jules.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks Sam! I'll keep that in mind. Jules is covering Maple Street and the community center, so if you want to help spread the word on other streets, that'd be awesome!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Rey. I'll make sure to bring everything they might need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'm glad you're so prepared, Gus. It'll make a big difference.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I just hope I don't forget anything important. I'll double-check my kit tonight.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Eli, have you seen the list of supplies we still need for the repair drive? I'm trying to get a full inventory.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I haven't seen the list myself, but I'd check the bulletin board at the community center—that's where all the details are posted.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, the bulletin board—that's a good idea. I'll swing by there later to check, thanks Eli!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: School calendar? Yeah, that could work. But I'm pretty sure I saw it somewhere... maybe the community center?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, then let's meet at the community center tomorrow at 10am to figure things out with the calendar.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Alright, 10am at the community center. I'll try to remember this time.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Uli, could you clarify which repair drive you're referring to? The server one or the laptop one?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Honestly, Hana, I'm a bit lost myself. I think it's the laptop one, but I'm not really keeping track.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Alright, let me double-check with someone who might know for sure.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Dane! The repair drive is coming along nicely. I'm helping Vik coordinate schedules—want me to fill you in on the details?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure, fill me in! I'm always late to the party, but I'm ready to help once I know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great! Vik's planning to set up a schedule this weekend. I can add you to the email list so you're in the loop!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Mina, I've been asking around about the repair drive. Vik said he's setting up a schedule this weekend and Jules is helping spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Is that for the server repair drive? I heard it might be broken.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Not the server, the neighborhood repair drive—fixing loose shingles and leaky spigots. Opal spotted some spots already.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Opal, I'm a bit anxious about the repair drive—do you know if they've sorted out the parking and scheduling?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven't heard about parking or scheduling, but I did notice some loose shingles on the Johnson house and a leaky spigot at the old Miller place—might be places to start.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, those sound like issues for sure, but are they even on the repair drive list? I hope we're not mixing up different projects.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure that repair drive is actually going to fix anything? I've seen these things fail before.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I just heard from Eli that it's this Saturday at the community center, so maybe we can check the bulletin board together and see if it looks legit.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A bulletin board posting? You really think that's reliable? I'd want to see some official confirmation before I trust it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh hi Bo! Have you heard about the repair drive this weekend? I'm so excited to get everyone together to fix things up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I heard. I think Rosa's got a list going—I'm supposed to grab some tools.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that's great! Rosa's so organized, she'll have everything sorted in no time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Leo! Have you heard about the repair drive? I'm helping organize it—want to join?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I'm in. What time and where?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great! It's this Saturday at 10 AM at the community center. Can you make it?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Kira, I understand your doubts, but we've moved the repair drive to Sunday at the community center—it'll be a great chance to tackle those issues together.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good, Rosa! I'll have the school calendar ready for our meeting tomorrow at your place at 10.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Mara! I'll have some coffee ready for us. See you at 10!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: We're meeting tomorrow at 10am at the community center to plan the repair drive with Mara and Eli. Can you join us?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure, I'll be there! I was planning to check the bulletin board anyway.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, see you then! I'll bring the school calendar.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Pia! Glad you're here. Just so you know, the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, Sunday? I hope they've sorted out parking—that lot fills up fast.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Don't worry, I've checked with the community center—they're opening the overflow lot for us.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Ira, you really think that repair drive is going to do anything? I've seen too many of these things fizzle out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I hear you, Kira, but Vik says he's setting up a schedule this weekend—and Jules is spreading the word. Plus Opal spotted some good starting points, so it's got more traction than usual.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, but have you actually seen this repair drive work before? I need some proof.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Vik, I heard about the repair drive... I might not be much help, but I hope it goes well.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes! I'm planning to set up a schedule this weekend, and Jules is going to help spread the word on Maple Street and at the community center group.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That's good to hear, Vik. I hope it all works out.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Dane, I'm ready to help with the repair drive. What's the plan?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Let me check with Rosa for the list first, then we can get started.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, I'll wait here. Let me know if you need me to grab anything from my toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Leo, have you heard what supplies we still need for the repair drive? I'm trying to round up a list.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I think we need more cables and a couple of spare hard drives. Check with Kira, she might have a list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Good idea, I'll ask Kira. You wouldn't happen to have any spare cables or hard drives lying around, would you?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I noticed the Johnson house needs new shingles and the Miller place has a leaky spigot. Hope that helps the drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Opal, are you talking about the server repair drive? I'm worried it might be broken.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: No, dear, I'm talking about the neighborhood repair drive for houses, not servers.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, hello! Are we still on for that repair drive this weekend? I hope I'm not mixing it up with something else.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, this weekend. I hope they've got the parking sorted.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Parking? Right, I think someone mentioned that. I hope I remember where I left my tools!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Jules, I heard about the repair drive. Need me to bring over my tool kit?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That'd be great, Gus! Vik's planning a schedule this weekend—want to help us coordinate?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can help with that. Just let me know when you want to meet up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, hey Mara! Did Faye mention we need the school calendar for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yeah, I told Faye I'd grab a copy of the school calendar. We're meeting tomorrow to plan the drive times around it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, so tomorrow it is! I'll make sure to remember this time.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 10am at the community center works for me. I'll see you there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Eli! I'll be there and I'll bring some extra tools too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That's great, Quinn. Extra tools will come in handy.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Bo, do you know which repair drive we're discussing—the server one or the laptop one?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Not sure, I think it's the one Gus mentioned... he's sending a list tonight.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Okay, thanks Bo. Let me know when Gus sends that list so I can confirm which drive it is.
